#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct Mod998 {
    static const long mod = 998244353;
    vector<long> factorial, invFactorial;

    Mod998() {
        factorial.push_back(1);
        invFactorial.push_back(1);
    }

    long fact(int n) {
        while ((int)factorial.size() <= n) {
            factorial.push_back(mult(factorial.back(), (int)factorial.size()));
        }
        return factorial[n];
    }

    long fInv(int n) {
        while ((int)invFactorial.size() <= n) {
            invFactorial.push_back(mult(invFactorial.back(), (int)invFactorial.size()));
        }
        return invFactorial[n];
    }

    long ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
        return mult(fact(n), mult(inv(fInv(r)), fInv(n - r)));
    }

    long smallInv(int n) {
        return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
    }

    long normalize(long x) {
        x %= mod;
        if (x < 0) x += mod;
        return x;
    }

    long add(long a, long b) {
        long v = a + b;
        return v < mod ? v : v - mod;
    }

    long subtract(long a, long b) {
        long v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + mod : v;
    }

    long mult(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }

    long mult(const vector<long>& x) {
        long r = 1;
        for (auto i : x) {
            r = mult(r, i);
        }
        return r;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    Mod998 mod;

    long phaseSize = 1;
    long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i);
        p = mod.mult(p, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long numPhases = mod.mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
        long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), numPhases);
        term = mod.mult(term, phaseSize);
        if ((k & 1) == 1)
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
